blocking: On desktop (index-desktop-4.jpg), the fixed header overlaps and clips the top half of thecream 'ANAR EVENTS' wordmark inside the brown 'Reimagined Heritage' CTA poster frame, creating a broken double-logo collision.

fixes.what: Increase top padding on `.cta--poster` (e.g., `padding-top: clamp(112px, 16vh, 160px)`) or increase `.cta__wordmark` top margin so the inner poster wordmark clears the 96px fixed header when scrolled into view.
fixes.why: In index-desktop-4.jpg, the fixed header's bottom edge slices directly through the `.cta__wordmark` SVG inside the poster frame.

fixes.what: Wrap `p.getTotalLength()` in a `try { ... } catch (e) {}` or guard against hidden SVGs, and recalculate inside a `ScrollTrigger` `onRefresh` callback.
fixes.why: `.journey__line--h` is `display:none` on mobile (<1024px) and `.journey__line--v` is `display:none` on desktop; calling `getTotalLength()` on `display:none` SVG paths returns 0 or throws in some browsers, breaking the line draw if the viewport is resized across the 1024px breakpoint.

fixes.what: Increase `.hero-toggle` touch target from `32px`/`36px` to `44px` × `44px` (or add a `-6px` invisible hit-area pseudo-element) on mobile.
fixes.why: At 32×32px on 390px mobile, the video pause/play button in the header is below the WCAG 2.5.5 / Apple HIG 44×44px minimum touch target size and sits only 6px from the 'Inquire' link.

fixes.what: Set `loading="lazy"` or defer assigning `.src` on `.hero__cloud--1` and `.hero__cloud--2` until after initial paint / window `load`.
fixes.why: Both 2752×1536 cloud WebPs start at `opacity: 0` off-screen and only appear on scroll, yet `site.js` immediately injects their `src` synchronously on DOMContentLoaded, competing with the hero poster and font for initial bandwidth.

fixes.what: When `.site-header.nav-open` is active on mobile, stop Lenis (`lenis.stop()`) and trap focus or close the drawer on outside click / scroll.
fixes.why: Opening the mobile menu leaves the background page scrollable via touch/Lenis while the absolute drawer hangs open.

fixes.what: Add `integrity` (SRI) and `crossorigin="anonymous"` attributes to the external `cdnjs` (GSAP/ScrollTrigger) and `unpkg` (Lenis) script tags.
fixes.why: Loading third-party scripts from public CDNs without Subresource Integrity hashes exposes the site to CDN supply-chain tampering.
